playback: Controller speaker only (firmware lines and app lines alike); never the PC speakers. The tour's first step asks whether the narrator should talk (sample through the controller, Yes/No); App settings has a Narrator voice on/off toggle. No controller = no voice. Masters: tools/master_voice.sh (approved by ear at full level).
buttonNames: She says "X" for the cross button (what players say), "circle", "square", "triangle".
culture: Translations reviewed for cultural fit (2026-10-10): no endearments outside English (British 'love' is neutral; chérie is gendered, amor/亲爱的 too intimate, Schatz patronizing); no Spain-only words that are vulgar elsewhere (coger -> tomar/usar); informal address (du/tu/tú, casual Japanese) is the norm for games and fits her style; button names as players say them per language (X/Kreis, croix/rond, equis/círculo, xis/bola, 叉/圈, バツ/マル). zh-CN: everyday words over homophone-prone jargon when spoken alone (按键≈案件, 槽位, 固件).
